title: Concept: Apache Tomcat error report disclosed in a response
description: The Apache Tomcat error report prints the container version next to the exception stack. It names classes and source paths inside the application and confirms the exact container version, which lets a reader match public issues to the deployment.
applicability: Responses served by a Tomcat container with the default error report.
risk: Stack traces and the container version reach the client; MEDIUM severity because the report is diagnostic output that aids exploit selection.
